value.rationale: This is the smallest nonsquare rectangular periodic Moore lattice having eight distinct neighbors at every vertex, an intrinsically motivated first comparison after the standard 4-by-4 full graph. Exact period spectrum 1,2,4,5,6,8,10, sharp 21-update entry clock, and a 23-class spatial reduction give useful finite dynamical benchmarks. The complete isolation of all eight five-cycles versus 9,340 states attracted to eight ten-cycles is a specific nontrivial basin distinction not determined by a fixed-point census.
